title: Large Language Model as Attributed Training Data Generator: A Tale of Diversity and Bias

bias_targets.methodology: Manually annotating and using a trained attribute classifier to measure the distribution of geographic locations (e.g., North America versus other continents) in LLM-generated news articles.

Using an attribute classifier to evaluate the distributional skew of various generated text characteristics, such as writing style, user experience sentiment, and problem scenarios across different datasets.
